name: TogglyCLI
description: Install a pinned Toggly CLI release and run caller-supplied arguments
helpMarkDown: Downloads a pinned `cli-v*` binary, verifies SHA256SUMS, and runs your arguments. Do not put secrets in `args`. [Learn more](https://docs.toggly.io/integrations/azure-devops)
author: Toggly

inputs.name: version
inputs.label: CLI version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Pinned CLI release without the `cli-v` prefix, for example `0.2.1`. Must be MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. Do not use `latest`.

inputs.name: args
inputs.label: CLI arguments
inputs.helpMarkDown: Arguments passed to toggly-cli. Quote like a shell. Do not put secrets here — use Client ID / Client Secret inputs instead.

inputs.name: clientId
inputs.label: Client ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: OAuth2 client ID. Mapped to TOGGLY_CLIENT_ID.

inputs.name: clientSecret
inputs.label: Client Secret
inputs.helpMarkDown: OAuth2 client secret. Mapped to TOGGLY_CLIENT_SECRET. Pass a secret pipeline variable (for example `$(TOGGLY_CLIENT_SECRET)`).
